title: Amazon makes its AI-powered Alexa+ free on Fire TV, no Prime required | TechCrunch
summary: Compatible devices include all the current-generation Amazon Fire TV Sticks, the Fire TV Cube, Amazon Ember smart TVs, and other smart TVs that have Alexa+ built in, including Hisense and Panasonic.
